fortnite.name: Fortnite
fortnite.minimum:
Processor: Intel Core i3-3225
Graphics: Intel HD 4000 or AMD Radeon Vega 8
Memory: 8 GB RAM
OS: Windows 10 22H2 64-bit or Windows 10 Enterprise 21H2 64-bit
fortnite.recommended:
Processor: Intel Core i5-7300U or AMD Ryzen 3 3300U
Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 or AMD R9 280 (2 GB VRAM)
Memory: 16 GB RAM
OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
Storage: NVMe SSD
Additional Notes: Epic Quality is a separate target: RTX 3070 / RX 6700 XT, 8 GB VRAM, i7-8700 / Ryzen 7 3700X, 16 GB RAM, NVMe SSD. Tournament security requirements are not tested by Radar.

rocketleague.name: Rocket League
rocketleague.minimum:
Processor: 2.5 GHz Dual Core
Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 or AMD Radeon R9 270X
Memory: 4 GB RAM
OS: Windows 7 64-bit or newer (publisher listing; verify current launcher support)
DirectX: 11
Storage: 20 GB available space
rocketleague.recommended:
Processor: 3.0+ GHz Quad Core
Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 470
Memory: 8 GB RAM
OS: Windows 7 64-bit or newer (publisher listing; verify current launcher support)
DirectX: 11
Storage: 20 GB available space

yoloex.name: Yolo.ex
yoloex.minimum:
Processor: Intel Core i7 or AMD Ryzen 5 1600X
Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 580
Memory: 16 GB RAM
OS: Windows 10 or later 64-bit
Storage: Around 10 GB free disk space
Additional Notes: Developer requirements are for an in-development build. The listed alternative GPUs differ substantially; validate with an actual run.
